fields.name: Visibility
fields.evidence: The whole 4-byte component. Windows per-frame update of ls::ClusterVisibilitySystem bg3.exe+0x3E66F20 (the only writer: the system's only 'write' component) gathers the camera data and calls the SSE float kernel bg3.exe+0x7B10 (all-float arithmetic) that fills the column; then marks each changed entity's ClusterVisibilityComponent (FUN_1440103b0 with its type index). Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0x145C10 ProcessVisibility writes it as one 4-byte value per cluster. Live: 48 values 0.2 .. -5.0 as floats. The raw check's 0x80000000 is -0.0f, an ordinary float (the sign of a zero product), not a sign that the member is not a float.

summary: Client scene streaming: per-cluster visibility score computed each frame from the camera and the cluster sphere (and cull-trigger planes); ClusterVisualLoaderSystem loads or unloads the cluster's visuals from it. On every cluster entity in idle levels.
open_questions: Meaning/scale of the value (a signed score; negative presumably outside the view) not decoded from the SIMD kernel - the layout does not depend on it.
second_pass: Size 4 = one member; the Windows writer bg3.exe+0x3E66F20 fills it from an SSE float kernel and live values are floats. The failed raw check was -0.0f (0x80000000), a valid float: the raw checker should accept negative zero.
raw_check: 48 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
